questions.answer: Remaining audit gaps are closed with command-backed evidence; adapter authors can implement replaceable integrations without reading harness internals; stricter contracts reject incomplete or unrelated evidence.
ExperienceContract incomplete -> complete; ValidationDatabase original -> copied -> verified

Approval evidence must contain real fileHashes; experience contracts must declare database mutation behavior; strict task completion must use the recorded red-green test file; original databases must remain unchanged during data validation; adapter contracts must be documented and modules must stay below architecture warning thresholds.

Validate experience contracts: run feature spec validation -> inspect missing Database Mutations -> require explicit None or mutation text; Validate SQLite copy test coverage: run validation tests -> verify copied database assertions -> compare original hash assertion; Replace inventory adapter: run configured inventory command -> merge command inventory with static inventory -> block malformed output.
Focused unit and e2e tests; full QA command suite; workflow doctor strict
feature validate-spec; feature complete-task-group; feature run-validation

Domain and application code remain independent of concrete shell, browser, and database adapters; shared process execution lives in src/adapters/commands; production database validation remains adapter-agnostic.
